calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctrl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2 AND c.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctrl_sales, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_sales AS gap
FROM weekly w LEFT JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_by_sale_date
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 OR p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_999_zz,
       SUM(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AND w.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_not_recognised,
       SUM(CASE WHEN w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL AND w.dispatch_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_null_dispatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_lines_no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
